newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline stays flat, swaps rise $2 in catch-up.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline stays flat, swaps rise $2 in catch-up.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were little changed on Friday but the underlying swaps market rose $2 a tonne in a catch-up with Thursday gains.
Rotterdam physical barges traded early at $197.75 a tonne but thereafter was quiet. May and June swaps ended about $2 higher at $197.75 and $197.50 respectively with June $3 lower.
Dealers said the arbitrage to the U.S. was still "just closed" at $22.50 a tonne freight. Most refiners in Europe need a freight of above $23 to make sales into the U.S. or Canada.
